conventions.decimals: inputs are decimal STRINGS and are read exactly (never through a float)
conventions.roots: real n-th root of A (principal root for even n) as a*b^(1/n)/c, gcd(a,c)=1, c>0, b free of n-th powers; a<0 only for odd n and A<0; 'undefined' for A<0 and even n; 'numeric' (exact form not attempted) when p*q^(n-1) >= 100000^(n+1) for |A|=p/q in lowest terms, unless |A| is a perfect n-th power (always exact)
conventions.powers: integer exponents; 0^0 and 0^(negative) are undefined by the book's convention
conventions.rules: a rule 'applies' when both of its sides are defined; whenever it applies the two sides are exactly equal
conventions.units: dimension = exponents of (metre, second, kilogram); add/subtract need equal tuples; sqrt needs a value >= 0 and all-even exponents

tolerance.rationale: Math.sqrt is correctly rounded from the nearest double to A (<= 1 ulp from the true root). Math.cbrt / Math.pow(x, 1/n) are not correctly rounded and 1/n is inexact, so n >= 3 gets headroom. Exact forms (a, b, c), undefined/numeric policies, power values, rule outcomes and unit strings must match EXACTLY.
